product_metadata.title: SONGMICS Luggage Rack, Luggage Rack for Guest Room, Suitcase Stand, Steel Frame, Foldable, for Bedroom, Gray URLR64GS
features: [Packing Made Easier] Make your guests feel at home with this convenient luggage rack. It elevates their suitcase to a comfortable height for packing and unpacking, saving you or your guests from bending down to the floor

[Ultimate Convenience] Standing at 27”L x 14.8”W x 22.6”H and folded to 27”L x 4.3”W x 26.7”H, the luggage rack doesn’t eat up too much space whether it’s in use or not—fold it flat to stow under the bed, in the closet, or just in the bedroom corner
[Floor Friendly] Equipped with PP plastic adjustable feet, this rack can balance itself even on slightly uneven floors; plus, your tiles, linoleum, and wood floors are protected from scratches

[No-Pain Assembly] Packing belongings is a painstaking task, and that’s why we pack in the easy-to-follow instructions and an Allen key, letting you set up this suitcase stand painlessly; it’ll be ready to help you pack for the next trip
[What You Get] A steel luggage rack for guest room that can accommodate 20”, 24”, or 26” suitcases. Its foldable, space-saving design makes packing or organizing belongings a breeze
